description: Automatic chip detection module - detect WiFi chipset from /sys/class/net, lspci, lsusb, ethtool, and iw info, then return optimal monitor mode configuration for that chip. Integrate with LinuxMonitorManager for automatic best-method selection (airmon-ng, iw, or direct driver commands).
steps: Create posframework/chip_detector.py with a ChipDetector class that probes multiple sources: (1) /sys/class/net/<iface>/device/driver symlink for kernel driver name, (2) /sys/class/net/<iface>/device/uevent for PCI/USB vendor:product IDs, (3) lspci -k output for PCI wireless devices, (4) lsusb output for USB wireless adapters, (5) ethtool -i <iface> for driver/firmware info, (6) iw dev <iface> info and iw phy <phy> info for capabilities. Return a ChipInfo dataclass with fields: driver, vendor (Intel/Broadcom/Atheros/Realtek/MediaTek/Ralink), model, bus_type (pci/usb), vendor_id, product_id, firmware_version, supported_modes, injection_support.

Add a MonitorMethodSelector class in posframework/chip_detector.py that takes a ChipInfo and returns the optimal monitor mode method: 'airmon-ng' for cards known to work best with airmon (ath9k, ath9k_htc), 'iw' for standard nl80211 cards (iwlwifi, mt76), 'driver' for cards requiring direct driver commands (rtl88xxau). Include a priority-ordered list of methods to try with fallback.

Create posframework/monitor_manager.py (new enhanced module) with an EnhancedMonitorManager class that: (1) auto-detects chip via ChipDetector, (2) selects best method via MonitorMethodSelector, (3) implements enable/disable with automatic cleanup via atexit and signal handlers (SIGINT, SIGTERM), (4) tracks interface state (original_name, current_name, original_mode, original_mac, monitor_active, method_used), (5) implements retry logic with fallback methods if primary method fails. Include methods: enable_monitor_mode(), disable_monitor_mode(), cleanup() registered with atexit, set_channel(), get_status() returning a dict of current state.

Add integration with the existing setup_monitor_mode() function in posframework/monitor_mode.py - update setup_monitor_mode() to optionally use EnhancedMonitorManager when available. Add a new function enhanced_setup_monitor_mode(interface) that uses the full chip detection pipeline.

Create tests/test_chip_detector.py with unit tests using unittest.mock to mock subprocess calls and /sys filesystem reads. Test: chip detection from various driver names, monitor method selection for different chipsets, fallback behavior when primary method fails, state tracking during enable/disable lifecycle.
Update posframework/__init__.py to export ChipDetector, ChipInfo, MonitorMethodSelector, EnhancedMonitorManager from the new modules.
acceptance_criteria: posframework/chip_detector.py passes AST validation (valid Python syntax)
ChipDetector class handles all 6 detection sources (sysfs, lspci, lsusb, ethtool, iw dev, iw phy)
MonitorMethodSelector returns different methods for different chip families (ath9k -> airmon-ng, iwlwifi -> iw, rtl88xxau -> driver)
EnhancedMonitorManager registers atexit cleanup handler and signal handlers
EnhancedMonitorManager implements retry with fallback methods
posframework/__init__.py imports the new classes without syntax errors
